issue_1_blank_candlestick_chart.observed_symptom: Veri yükleniyor veya bu dönem için mum kaydı bulunamadı... displayed on staging chart while local dev showed candles.
issue_1_blank_candlestick_chart.root_cause: .gitignore line 50 contained data/binance_spot_multiyear/. Coolify performs git clone from GitHub repository; because parquet files were ignored by git, the container built on Linux VPS had an empty data directory. Furthermore, Dockerfile omitted COPY research_outputs/ ./research_outputs/.
issue_1_blank_candlestick_chart.remediation: Updated .gitignore to ignore only the large 1m partition (210 MB) while explicitly tracking 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, and 1d partitions (total 65 MB across 285 Parquet files, all < 1 MB each). Added COPY research_outputs/ ./research_outputs/ to Dockerfile. All 285 files committed to repository.

issue_2_hardcoded_git_sha.observed_symptom: Header badge, overview meta, and operations telemetry statically displayed '2e7ad236ba07f71eee54dac01d6ffe9c115ba9d9' regardless of actual deployment revision.
issue_2_hardcoded_git_sha.root_cause: Hardcoded string in dashboard_api.py and dashboard_ui.py.
issue_2_hardcoded_git_sha.remediation: Implemented get_runtime_git_revision() in dashboard_api.py with a 4-tier fallback: 1) GIT_COMMIT / SOURCE_COMMIT / COOLIFY_GIT_COMMIT env vars; 2) Local .git/HEAD inspection; 3) git rev-parse HEAD subprocess call; 4) build_metadata.json lookup. Updated dashboard_ui.py to dynamically populate all .dyn-git-rev and .dyn-git-rev-short spans via /api/v1/product/overview and /api/v1/product/operations.

issue_3_environment_qualification_ambigu.observed_symptom: Operations tab showed 5 fsync benchmark failures without distinguishing between host disk virtualization bottlenecks and live Linux VPS performance.
issue_3_environment_qualification_ambigu.root_cause: Unified display conflated Windows NTFS / WSL2 virtualized disk queuing benchmarks with live Linux container telemetry.
issue_3_environment_qualification_ambigu.remediation: Segregated Operations telemetry into Section A (Live Linux VPS Staging Container Metrics - Healthy/Normal), Section B (Offline Windows WSL2 Durability Benchmarks - Root cause documented as NTFS virtualization queue depth), and Section C (Cryptographic Governance Invariants).
